method: Independent mixed-precision experiment: same named raw ONNX + ModelOpt INT8 PTQ; selected ConvTranspose nodes excluded together and retained as FP16; each Q/DQ graph compiled by TensorRT.
graph_scope: Current Generator graph contains ConvTranspose/BatchNorm/ReLU/Tanh. No wavelet or dynamic-SN node is assumed.

design_rationale.net.0+net.12: Primary combination: net.0 had the lowest single-layer speed cost and net.12 had the strongest single-layer FID recovery in the preceding screening.
design_rationale.net.9+net.12: Interaction test for net.9's blur improvement versus its FID degradation.
design_rationale.net.0+net.9: No-final-layer control for whether net.9's blur behavior is independent of the output block.
design_rationale.net.0+net.3+net.12: Overhead control: tests whether adding a weak single-layer candidate is justified.

final_note: For the report, rerun with --n-fid 5000 and retain this CSV, plot, manifest, recommendation, and selected engine as the final evidence.
